Threat_Event: Ransomware deployment encrypting corporate databases and endpoints
Vulnerability: Outdated endpoint protection and lack of centralized EDR agent
ISO_27001_Annex_A_Control: A.8.7 (Protection against malware) & A.8.19 (Installation of software on operational systems)
Control_Description: Deploy enterprise EDR (Trend Micro / CrowdStrike) with automated host isolation and daily immutable cloud backups

Threat_Event: Unauthorized access to cloud infrastructure via credential stuffing or password reuse
Vulnerability: Absence of enforced Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on legacy management portals
Control_Description: Mandate hardware token / authenticator app MFA via IdP (Okta / Entra ID) and deprecate legacy authentication protocols

Threat_Event: Ex-employee retains access to internal systems post-termination (privilege creep / orphaned accounts)
Vulnerability: Manual offboarding workflow without automated deprovisioning between HRIS and Active Directory
Control_Description: Integrate HRIS webhook with IdP for instant JML offboarding within 4 hours; institute quarterly User Access Reviews (UAR)

Threat_Event: Exposure of customer PII stored in unencrypted public cloud storage buckets
Vulnerability: Misconfigured access control lists (ACLs) and lack of default storage encryption policies
ISO_27001_Annex_A_Control: A.8.12 (Data leakage prevention) & A.8.24 (Use of cryptography)
Control_Description: Implement CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) policy enforcing KMS-managed AES-256 encryption and public block rules

Threat_Event: Data compromise resulting from security breach at a Tier-1 SaaS vendor
Vulnerability: Lack of formal vendor risk assessment (TPRM) and missing SOC 2 Type II audit report reviews
ISO_27001_Annex_A_Control: A.5.19 (Information security in supplier relationships) & A.5.21 (Managing ICT supply chain security)
Control_Description: Establish formal Supplier Security Policy requiring annual SOC 2 review

Threat_Event: SQL Injection / Remote Code Execution in public-facing customer portal
Vulnerability: Insufficient input validation and lack of automated SAST/DAST testing in CI/CD pipeline
Control_Description: Embed OWASP ZAP and SonarQube automated scanning into GitHub Actions; mandate annual external penetration testing

Threat_Event: Critical zero-day operating system vulnerability exploited prior to patching
Vulnerability: Patching cycle exceeds 60 days due to lack of staging automation
Control_Description: Deploy automated patch management tool; enforce SLA of 7 days for critical CVEs and 14 days for high CVEs

Threat_Event: Executive credential compromise and wire fraud via spear-phishing attack
Vulnerability: Absence of advanced email filtering and lack of employee simulation training
Residual_Impact: SPF); conduct monthly automated phishing simulations and training

Threat_Event: Confidential proprietary code and customer data leaked to third-party public AI models (Shadow AI)
Vulnerability: Staff using unsanctioned generative AI tools without data privacy guardrails
ISO_27001_Annex_A_Control: ISO 42001 A.6.2 (AI System impact) & A.8.12 (Data leakage prevention)
Control_Description: Publish AI Acceptable Use Policy; block unapproved AI domains at DNS/firewall; deploy enterprise private AI sandbox

Threat_Event: Extended datacenter power outage or natural catastrophe halting operations >48 hours
Vulnerability: Incomplete multi-region failover and unverified backup restoration procedures
ISO_27001_Annex_A_Control: A.5.29 (Information security during disruption) & A.8.13 (Information backup)
Control_Description: Establish multi-AZ automated failover with 4-hour RTO and 1-hour RPO; perform semi-annual disaster recovery simulation drill
